_help: Home-screen Merchant (Skillz, DESIGN.md §20). Sells rolled guns for Gravemarks. Read by scripts/merchant/merchant.gd. stock_size 4..6 (clamped). slots[i] = rarity weights (common..mythic, relative) for stock slot i; slots past the end reuse the last entry. featured = that slot gets featured_bonus (extra IP, extra perk, price x price_mult). rarity.<id>: price in Gravemarks, item_power [min, max] rolled uniformly (passed to GearDB.roll_weapon, so it replaces the round-based drop IP), bonus_perks added on top of Rarity.PERK_SLOTS. Stock refreshes every refresh_seconds, aligned to multiples of refresh_seconds since the unix epoch (top of the hour). reroll_costs[n] = price of the (n+1)th paid reroll since the last free refresh; past the end, the last cost + reroll_cost_step per extra use. rollback_reanchor_seconds: if the clock goes back further than this behind last_seen_time, the stock is kept and the timer re-anchors to the corrected clock (no early refresh). income_per_match = Gravemarks per typical match (easy/medium/hard) used for matches_to_afford() and the design table.
